ext_name.description: Extension name (brand, kept identical across locales).

ext_desc.message: Sends tab audio and window positions to nyan Real's Audio Wall (the OBS plugin or the standalone Spatial Wall app) over a local WebSocket, so each browser window sounds from where it is on the virtual screen.
ext_desc.description: Extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the store listing.

options_port_label.message: WebSocket port (match the Audio Wall port in nyan Real - the OBS plugin or standalone Spatial Wall; default 8796):

options_note.message: Audio from playing tabs is heard only through nyan Real (the tab itself goes silent).
